scope: Direct operator restaurant leads for seven Odisha cities. Operator descriptions establish advertised dining, not independent quality assessments. No newly collected venue has a dish-story association.

venues.name: Odisha Hotel — Cuttack
venues.area: Cuttack — ask for the exact branch address
venues.description: Odia cooking from the Odisha Hotel group. Its official contact page lists a Cuttack branch; ask the restaurant for the address before setting out.

venues.name: Zaikedaar Dhaba
venues.description: Thalis, tandoori dishes and curries at a dhaba on NH16 in Pratapnagari.

venues.name: Nimantran — Puri
venues.description: OTDC’s Odia restaurant by Blue Flag Beach, with regional dishes and rooftop dining.

venues.name: Pearl at Empires Puri
venues.description: Pearl serves traditional Odia recipes alongside Chinese dishes at Empires Hotel.

venues.name: Vayu at Shankar Bhavan
venues.description: A rooftop restaurant at Shankar Bhavan, offering a multi-cuisine menu.

venues.name: Julian Restaurant
venues.area: Remuna Golei, opposite Reliance petrol pump
venues.description: Indian, Chinese and tandoori dishes near Remuna Golei.

venues.name: Barjorjis Banjara restaurant
venues.description: A restaurant at Barjorjis Banjara on O.T. Road. Contact the hotel for the current menu and dining arrangements.

venues.name: Swad Sadan at The Balkrishna Palace
venues.description: A rooftop restaurant serving Odia, North Indian and continental food. The hotel also welcomes walk-in diners.

venues.name: Dining at Hotel Signature
venues.area: Second Lane, Nehru Nagar, Mill Street, near Vedika Lawn
venues.description: The hotel’s restaurant offers Odia, Indian and continental dishes in Nehru Nagar.

venues.name: Dining at Raj Residency
venues.description: Hotel dining on Post Office Road, with multi-cuisine meals and breakfast. Ask about restaurant access if you are not staying.

venues.name: Mosaic at Empires Paradeep
venues.description: A multi-cuisine restaurant at Empires Hotel in Paradip.

venues.name: Hotel Sea Pearl restaurant
venues.description: Dining at Hotel Sea Pearl in Udaybat, with Indian, Middle Eastern and Oriental food advertised by the hotel.

Empires Paradeep page contains placeholder contact details; no phone number copied.
Bidhan has Sunabeda and Semiliguda addresses; not placed in Koraput town.
Hotel dining is not assumed to establish a particular dish or unrestricted access for non-residents.
